summary.title: Garmin Connect IQ complication support
changes: A new Complication option is available in the Garmin watch settings.
You can display Trio glucose, IOB, COB, and sensitivity ratio on any Garmin watchface with Connect IQ complicationslots.
The Complication app provides a 2-hour internal glucose graph using recent historical readings.
Select Complication before changing your watchface so data transmission can be resumed correctly.
